available_book_consensus.method: equal-weight mean of available already-validated book no-vig probabilities; once per native match

protocol.prediction_partition: TEST only; strictly after VALIDATION cutoff
protocol.cohort_rule: all-book common native IDs; per-book model and bookmaker identical native IDs
protocol.book_probability: two-sided proportional no-vig: (1 / price_team1) / (1 / price_team1 + 1 / price_team2)
protocol.quote_selection: latest stored fixture/book observation supplied by caller; no fallback to older rows
protocol.quote_cutoff: both aware side clocks strictly before min(scheduled start, true start); current receipt also strictly before cutoff; additionally both side clocks and current receipt strictly before explicit prediction forecast_origin_utc, bounded by source-day opening and event start
protocol.sensitivity_interpretation: source-day cutoff is a nominal UTC proxy applied to stored latest observations, not reconstructed snapshots or certified equal-information/closing prices; no execution or ROI claim
protocol.model_cutoff: explicit declared forecast_origin_utc, no earlier than nominal source-day opening; not a certified feature release clock
protocol.market: CS series Winner market 171, outcomes 171/172, player 0 catalog convention
protocol.paired_interval: model-minus-book log loss and Brier; source-day blocks sampled with replacement; match-weighted mean; 5000 draws seed 42; percentile 95% interval
protocol.undefined_scores: empty scalar metrics null; empty calibration bins []; single-class ROC AUC null

limits: The broader downloaded/mapped pool is not the frozen player-model TEST population; missing predictions are not extrapolated or fitted.

No invented player identities or pre-match lineups. Existing predictions are conditional on their saved lineup/source evidence; missing prediction reasons and original lineup availability are not independently certified.
HLTV source dates are calendar days with uncertified original timezone; synthetic noon is never treated as an actual kickoff or information cutoff.
Stored bookmaker prices are latest pre-start observations, not equal information cutoffs to the day-frozen model; a source-day UTC proxy does not certify original feature release clocks.
Historical observed_at is download receipt time, not source price time and not proof the quote was obtainable before the match.
Provider Winner/outcome/player-0 bindings follow catalog conventions; executable entity, market and price availability remain not certified.
Bookmaker availability differs. Comparisons on differing sample populations cannot establish a model advantage; only identical-ID paired cohorts are scored.

Day-block intervals are descriptive sampling uncertainty, not profitability evidence. Zero-crossing intervals do not support a significance claim; a single source day yields a degenerate interval with no between-day uncertainty information.
No actionable betting, execution, profitability or statistical significance claim is made, even for intervals excluding zero.
timed_prediction_cohort_rule: frozen TEST intersect valid native/provider forecast-origin evidence; no score-based exclusions
